display_name: Hamilton Intra-Matic H38735501 42mm, PVD gold, brown smoked dial

evidence.quote: The Hamilton Intra-Matic watches I reviewed here are the reference H38455781 (38mm steel, grey smoked dial) and H38735501 (42mm, PVD gold, brown smoked dial).
Caliber ETA 2892-A2 Inside these Hamilton Intra-Matic 38mm and 42mm models, we find the same mechanical self-winding movement.
evidence.locator: Caliber ETA 2892-A2 section; same movement in both reviewed references
